recommendations.description: Conduct a Commercial Local Group inpatient auth-to-claim, authorization enforcement, and claims reprocessing audit for AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION and CA PPO Not Mapped claims in NY, CT, CA, GA, OH, and VA, reconciling PA-required and facility-type logic for NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL TISCH HOSPITAL, YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL, IU HEALTH METHODIST UNIVERSITY, HENRICO DOCTORS' HOSPITAL, Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC, and Postpartum and Postabortion Diagnoses without O.R. Procedures, then rerun provider, DRG, and product comparisons before UM or reimbursement action.
evidence: AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION drove change across NY, CT, CA, GA, OH, and VA.
NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL TISCH HOSPITAL led NY provider concentration.
YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL concentrated CT AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION change.
CA PPO facility_type Not Mapped indicates facility classification cleanup.
Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC and postpartum DRGs were named drivers.
IU HEALTH METHODIST UNIVERSITY and HENRICO DOCTORS' HOSPITAL led other state concentrations.
peer_benchmarking: Point32Health marks authorization required under general editing, eligibility, benefits, and authorization rules.
Emblem Health applies broad coding edits across obstetric, surgical, and facility services.
United Health applies general facility inclusive-charges bundling rules.

recommendations.description: Open a CT PPO acute inpatient policy audit centered on Yale New Haven Hospital and Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC to validate PA-required and non-PA claim matching, enforce authorization outcomes, review admission, level-of-care, and site-of-care controls, and confirm reimbursement compliance.
evidence: Yale PA-required PPO acute cases added about $3.8M.
PA-required Yale admissions rose 38; paid per admit rose about $9K.
Yale non-PA admissions rose 43; paid per admit rose about $3K.
Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC added about $235K on four admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Point32Health reclassifies short inpatient stays to observation, generally limited to 48 hours.
United Health bundles routine inpatient and outpatient facility services and supplies.

recommendations.description: Launch a focused inpatient reimbursement and program-integrity audit for NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL TISCH HOSPITAL on PA-required EPO acute hospital admissions, starting with Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC, to validate authorization-to-claim matching, DRG classification, contract-compliant payment, and reprocessing or contract remediation where mismatches are found.
evidence: Spend increase is heavily concentrated at NYU Langone Hospital Tisch Hospital.
All key cells are PA-required NY EPO acute hospital admissions.
Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC is the largest clinical driver.
Validation note calls for PA status and claim classification confirmation.
peer_benchmarking: Highmark_BCBS applies hospital-setting bundling for inpatient claims.

recommendations.description: Create a targeted inpatient provider-product watchlist for GA POS IU HEALTH METHODIST UNIVERSITY, VA PPO HENRICO DOCTORS' HOSPITAL, CA PPO IU HEALTH METHODIST UNIVERSITY and NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL TISCH HOSPITAL, and NH POS OHIO STATE UNIVERSITY WEXNER MEDICAL CENTER; confirm prior authorization on PA-required admissions, enforce authorization denials, and verify claims processed per contractual obligation before contract remediation or site-of-care action.
evidence: GA POS IU Health Methodist added admissions with sharply higher paid per admit.
VA PPO Henrico Doctors' Hospital added admissions and higher paid per admit.
CA PPO pressure concentrated at IU Health Methodist, NYU Langone, and Henrico.
Many contributing cells were PA-required and flagged for auth dimension presence.
peer_benchmarking: United Health bundles routine services and supplies into facility charges.

recommendations.description: Implement a provider- and diagnosis-specific acute inpatient utilization management policy review that separates pa_required_code Y from N, confirms authorization on Y admissions, and audits referral and elective-admission pathways for PPO and POS acute hospital segments in OH, CA, VA, WI, CT, MO, and IN, prioritizing Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, Henrico Doctors' Hospital, Acute Myocardial Infarction, Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC, and Postpartum and Postabortion Diagnoses without O.R. Procedures.
evidence: OH Ohio State PPO acute hospital added $0.8M with 23 more admissions.
CA PPO digestive, AMI, postpartum DRGs rose with flat to down unit cost.
VA Henrico POS acute hospital added 23 admissions with paid per admit down.
WI POS AMI admissions increased from one to six while paid per admit fell.

recommendations.description: Initiate provider-level outlier review and payment-integrity audit for NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL TISCH HOSPITAL, OHIO STATE UNIVERSITY WEXNER MEDICAL CENTER, and HENRICO DOCTORS' HOSPITAL IP Med/Surg episodes tied to Coronary Bypass without Cardiac Catheterization with MCC, Cardiac Valve and Other Major Cardiothoracic Procedures without Cardiac Catheterization with MCC, Wound Debridement and Skin Graft Except Hand for Musculoskeletal and Connective Tissue Disorders with MCC, Cervical Spinal Fusion with CC, and Other Digestive System Diagnoses with MCC, including DRG/diagnosis validation, itemized bill review, and contract remediation assessment.
evidence: NY rare IP Med/Surg outliers added about $2.6M.
NYU Langone coronary bypass paid about $448K.
Ohio State wound debridement and skin graft paid about $401K.
Cardiac valve without cath with MCC added about $1.0M.
Most contributing cases involved 1 to 3 admissions.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health: no separate reimbursement for robotic surgical assistance; no DRG-specific limitation identified.

recommendations.description: Initiate case-level audit of Yale New Haven Hospital, Henrico Doctors' Hospital, and IU Health Methodist University admissions for Tracheostomy with Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours and Kidney Transplant in CT, GA, and VA to verify prior authorization enforcement, authorization-to-actual matching, contract carve-outs, inpatient bundling, and itemized bill accuracy.
evidence: PA required indicator is Y on Yale, IU Health Methodist, and Henrico cases.
Variance is concentrated in Yale New Haven, Henrico Doctors', and IU Health Methodist.
Drivers are tracheostomy with prolonged ventilation and kidney transplant DRGs.
Diagnoses include sepsis unspecified organism, MSSA sepsis, and end stage renal disease.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance bundles admission-related outpatient services into inpatient payment, excluding ambulance, dialysis, SNF, and home health.
United Health bundles routine services and supplies; separate reimbursement limited to daily facility-owned ventilator or CPAP management.
